name: How to Plan for Kitchen Cabinetry?

step.name: Step 1: Define Your Needs and Budget. Start by honestly assessing what your current kitchen lacks. Do you need more storage, better flow for entertaining, or updated aesthetics? Consider your ideal style and how much you're comfortable investing. Having a clear vision and budget helps guide all subsequent decisions, ensuring a managed process from the start.

Consider your ideal style and how much you're comfortable investing. Having a clear vision and budget helps guide all subsequent decisions, ensuring a managed process from the start.

step.name: Step 2: Measure and Verify. Accurate measurements are non-negotiable. This includes wall dimensions, ceiling height, and the precise locations of windows, doors, and utilities. Crucially, finalize your appliance selections *before* any cabinetry orders. Dishwashers, refrigerators, and ranges all have specific clearance requirements that custom cabinetry can be designed around, but only if known upfront. AKN Design Group emphasizes this detail to prevent costly mistakes.

step.name: Step 3: Develop Drawings and Specifications. Work with a qualified designer to create detailed layouts. These drawings should show not just the cabinet placement, but also door swings, clearances for pathways, filler pieces, and the exact locations of outlets. Don't be afraid to ask for revisions until everything feels right. This is where the magic of residential design-build truly shines, harmonizing vision with execution.

step.name: Step 4: Approve the Final Design. Before any manufacturing begins, thoroughly review the finalized plans. Check for anything that might have been overlooked, like comfortable reach to upper cabinets or adequate prep space. Confirm materials, finishes, hardware, and any specialized storage features. This is your last chance to make changes without incurring significant delays or costs, ensuring the craftsmanship meets your expectations.

step.name: Step 5: Schedule and Coordinate. Understand the lead times for custom cabinetry, which can be 8–16 weeks or more. Coordinate delivery and installation with other trades like plumbers and electricians, especially if your project involves utility changes. A clear, milestone schedule with approval points is critical. AKN Design Group provides a single point of coordination for complex projects, streamlining this entire process.
step.text: What to Expect During the Process Once your design is approved and cabinets are ordered, manufacturing will begin. When they arrive, a skilled team will handle the installation, ensuring proper leveling, secure fastening, and meticulous alignment. This typically takes 2–5 days for a kitchen. After installation, countertop templating follows, with plumbing, electrical, backsplash, and appliance work scheduled. A final walkthrough will confirm every detail meets your approval. Our integrated design-build approach aims to make this complex journey seamless, building trust and delivering lasting impressions.
